label: Target gain
definition: Fusion energy divided by driver energy delivered at the specified target boundary.
guardrail: Not electrical gain; preserve driver type and denominator.

label: Peak plasma gain
definition: Peak fusion power divided by the declared external plasma-heating power.
guardrail: Peak values are not necessarily sustained; heating electricity lies outside this denominator.

label: Fusion energy per discharge
definition: Fusion energy integrated over the stated discharge interval.
guardrail: An energy quantity is not power or electricity.

label: H-mode duration
definition: Duration in the source-specified high-confinement regime.
guardrail: Show facility, fuel and conditions; it is not energy-confinement time or a universal gain rank.

label: Plasma discharge duration
definition: Duration of the reported maintained plasma discharge.
guardrail: Externally supplied heating is not fusion yield.

label: Duration above stated ion temperature
definition: Time for which the stated ion-temperature threshold was maintained.
guardrail: Do not replace ion temperature with electron temperature or combine separate campaign maxima.

label: High-performance interval
definition: Duration of the specific high-triple-product operating interval reported by the facility.
guardrail: Not a universal maximum triple product, total pulse duration or energy-confinement time.
